title: Laravel AI SDK 1.4 Lets Agents Recover From Tool Failures
content:
Laravel AI SDK 1.4 sends tool exceptions back to the model instead of ending the run, and lets agent fakes resume tool approvals in tests.

The post Laravel AI SDK 1.4 Lets Agents Recover From Tool Failures appeared first on Laravel News.
